relevance_note: Chinese case report of one family in which the proband and his father carry a heterozygous TNFAIP3 exon 2-9 deletion and are diagnosed with HA20: '拷贝数变异分析发现先证者及其父亲存在TNFAIP3外显子2~9杂合缺失'.
method_note: Read the whole paper (Chinese full text; no tables, the supplementary table 附表1 listing 19 TNFAIP3-CNV patients is not included, only '本文附加文件见电子版'; figures 1-3 incl. the pedigree are captions only). Rows were typed by hand into a small Python script that only assembled the JSON; every span was then checked by script against the paper. In-scope people: the proband Ⅲ-4, his father Ⅱ-4 (both carriers), and his mother (tested by whole-exome sequencing with CNV analysis, deletion reported only in proband and father; no pedigree label is printed, so 'mother of Ⅲ-4'). Previously published people with individual-level detail in the Discussion also got rows: the ref ［6］ child (same exon 2-9 deletion), the adult-onset ref ［7］ patient (one of the 19 CNV patients, variant only in the unavailable supplement, so variant_original_string 'not reported'), two brothers from the ref ［20］ Japanese survey (HA20 family; no variant printed, so no variant rows), and the ref ［9］ girl with her carrier mother. Labels for relatives translate the Chinese relation word (父母/母亲 -> mother, 哥哥 -> older brother); reference numbers keep the full-width brackets as printed. No rows for: untested, unaffected 'other family members' (家系中其他成员...未进行基因检测), described only as a group (and not applied to the tested mother); the 19-patient and 54-patient group statistics; the two ref ［13，16］ families and three ref ［20］ families described only at group level. Proband: age 3岁4个月 is the age at the 2024-01-11 presentation given in the case header; follow-up continued 1.5 years after that, and the age at last follow-up is not printed. Country not recorded: only the treating hospital (Xiamen) is given. Inheritance 'inherited paternal' for Ⅲ-4 rests on the father carrying the same deletion after trio testing and on the statement that this family is among '3个父系或母系遗传的HA20家系'; no sentence says 'inherited from the father' literally. qPCR of exons 2-9 ('qPCR检测各外显子相对表达量，结果见图3') was treated as confirmation of the deletion, not functional evidence; results are only in Fig. 3. Timepoint absences: 'oral mucosa without ulcers' at admission and 'no ulcers' on post-treatment colonoscopy are recorded as excluded rows with the timepoint in severity_or_detail; they are not contradictions of the recurrent oral ulcers / pre-treatment colorectal ulcers, so the checklist keeps those observed. Narrow absences not used for composite checklist items: 'no rash/petechiae/ecchymosis' (skin lesions item left not reported) and 'superficial lymph nodes not enlarged' (lymphoproliferation item left not reported; abdominal hypoechoic nodules of unstated nature). Father's ESR 28 mm/1 h, CRP 9.67 mg/L and faecal calprotectin 176 μg/g are printed without being called abnormal and without his reference ranges, so no feature rows and inflammatory-marker checklist not reported. Suspected small-bowel wall thickening ('可疑增厚') not recorded. Infection screens and HLA-B27 negativity not recorded as phenotypes. Ref ［6］ 'fever' is not stated as recurrent, so the recurrent-fever checklist item is not reported; perianal ulcers were not counted as genital or gastrointestinal ulcers. Older ref ［20］ brother's 'severe nervous system symptoms' not mapped to central nervous system involvement. Mother of the ref ［9］ girl: 'no clinical symptoms' recorded as one excluded row; checklist left not reported because no specific feature is named. Contradictions/oddities in the paper: (1) father's gastroscopy says chronic NON-atrophic gastritis while his biopsy says mild chronic ATROPHIC gastritis with intestinal metaplasia (both recorded as observed); (2) Zhang et al. ［9］ is cited among the CNV reports ［6-19］, but the ref ［9］ girl described in the text has a nonsense variant c.1300_1301delinsTA (p.A434*), not a CNV. n_patients_reported = 2 (proband and father, the first-hand patients); the authors' count of 19 CNV patients (including these two) refers to the supplementary literature table. First author is not printed in the file.
